label: DRT4 system
definition: A DRT system in which an organism possesses a genome-encoded DefenseFinder DRT_4 subtype locus represented by the DRT_4__drt4 profile.
observations: DRT4 branch under DRT system; distinct from the broader DRT system, the individual DRT4 reverse-transcriptase profile row, unresolved DRT4 phage triggers, direct RT products, host breadth, partner features, and other DRT subtypes.
